service.name: Musicians for farmers markets, libraries and rec centers
service.serviceType: Performers for farmers markets, library programs and concert series, recreation center events and summer concert series
service.description: A singer with a guitar, a solo guitarist, an acoustic duo, a jazz duo, an Americana band or a sound bath for farmers markets, library programs and concert series, rec center and community center events and summer concert series across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor, on a battery-powered system where there's no power, with a certificate of insurance, a W-9 and an invoice that matches the purchase order.

faqs.q: Do you book musicians for farmers markets?
faqs.a: Yes. A singer with a guitar, a solo guitarist or an acoustic duo plays a market morning in sets with breaks, on a battery-powered system or none at all where the market has no power, and a whole season of Saturdays can be booked with one enquiry. Tell us the market, the hours and whether there's power, and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price.

faqs.q: Can you play a library program or a concert series?
faqs.a: Yes. A solo or a duo plays an adult program, an older adults' afternoon or a Sunday afternoon set in the meeting space or the atrium at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest seat, a guitarist plays a small space without amplification, and a summer concert on the lawn or in the park takes a duo, a trio or the Americana band. Firstwater's sound bath books for library wellness programs too.

faqs.q: What does a rec center need to host live music?
faqs.a: A corner or a stage: 6 by 4 feet for a solo, 8 by 6 for a duo, 12 by 8 for a trio, and one dedicated 20-amp circuit, or two for a quartet. Load-in is 45 minutes to an hour before the program, and the sound system that fits the space comes with the booking. A certificate of insurance naming the district and a W-9 come with the contract.

Not for a guitarist or a singer with a guitar, who play on a battery-powered system or without one. A band with drums needs one dedicated 20-amp circuit, and a park stage with its own sound system needs a word with whoever runs it beforehand.

faqs.q: Do you work with purchase orders and city vendor paperwork?
faqs.a: Yes. A W-9, a certificate of insurance naming the city, the district or the library as additional insured, and one itemised invoice that matches the purchase order come in the same email as the contract, so a business office can set up the vendor before the first date.

faqs.q: How much does a musician cost for a community event?
faqs.a: We publish no prices of our own. What a solo musician, a duo or a band costs in this market, with sources, is on the pricing page, and a season of dates is priced as a run. Send the dates and the venue and we'll price them.
